title: P1 card.details and card.remind: request
description: The buttons "Details" (card.details) and "Remind approvers" (card.remind) on a card or the initiator's copy. The core checks the permission for the record (data:<class> not lower than the mark) and records the opening for the details_opened field; card.remind at most once in 5 minutes per approval, otherwise service_rate_limited (APR-19). Who pressed and from which chat, the channel passes in the headers Botaru-On-Behalf and Botaru-Chat by the on-behalf schema (spec/bindings/http/README.md); the body has no such fields.

subject_kind.description: Decision subject from a closed list. v0.1: approval, proposal, memory_record, campaign, script, script_gate, control, subject_request (kind erase, D-76); v0.2: takeover, governance_case, attribution and subject_request of kind export.

nonce.description: One-time value of the card: the button carries it together with the subject and id (APR-3).
